definition: To add a number to another number is to increase it by that amount.
To align two or more objects is to place them in a straight line.
To assess something is to study it and evaluate its qualities and properties.
If something is axial, it relates to movement along or parallel to the axis of something.
An axle is a shaft that connects two wheels.
A ball bearing is a rolling contact bearing that uses metal spheres to direct motion.
A ball peen hammer is a hammer with a rounded end on one side of the head and a flat end on the other side.
A band saw is a machine tool that is made of a steel blade that runs over wheels, which is used to cut various materials.
A bar graph is a graph that displays data in a series of bars, with each bar sized relatively to its value.
A base unit is one of seven standard SI units that is the foundation of other SI units.
A beam coupling is a flexible coupling that is made by cutting a spiral shape from one piece of material.
A bearing is a mechanical component that allows controlled motion of rotating shafts relative to stationary parts.
A belt drive is a machine component that uses a flexible belt mounted to two or more pulleys to transmit power, rotation, and torque.
A bevel gear is a gear in the shape of a partial cone, allowing gears to meet at right angles.
A box wrench is a wrench that fits around a six-sided nut.
A broach is a machine tool that is used to remove material.
If a subject is broad, it involves a wide variety of topics and disciplines.
If a measurement is Celsius, it uses the temperature scale in which water boils at 100° and freezes at 0°.
A chain drive is a machine component that uses a chain mounted to two or more pulleys to transmit power while ensuring synchronous rotation.
A CNC (computer numerically controlled) mill is a mill that is operated by a computer.
A column is a group of boxes that extends from the top to the bottom of a table.
To convert something is to change it into a different form or system of measurement.
A coupling is a piece of hardware that connects two shafts end-to-end in order to transmit energy.
If a number is cubed, it has an exponent of 3. For example, 2 cubed (23) equals 8, or 2 x 2 x 2 = 8.
A cubic centimeter, also called a milliliter, is a metric unit of volume equal to 1/1000 liter or about 0.03 fluid ounces.
A cubic meter is a metric unit of volume equal to 1,000 liters or about 35.31 cubic feet.
A decimal number is a number in a numbering system based on the number 10, with whole quantities on the left of the decimal point and partial quantities on the right.
A derived unit is an SI unit that is formed by a relationship between base units.
To design something is to create the plans for its construction.
To divide a number (A) by another number (B) is to split number A evenly into B number of parts.
A drill press is a machine tool that is used for drilling holes.
To equal something is to be precisely the same number or amount as something.
An exponent is part of an equation that shows how many times a number is multiplied by itself. For instance, in the equation 23 = 8, the exponent is 3.
If a measurement is Fahrenheit, is uses the temperature scale in which water boils at 212° and freezes at 32°.
If something is flexible, it can bend or change shape without breaking.
A fluid ounce is an imperial unit of volume equal to 1⁄128 gallon or about 28.41 milliliters.
A foot is an imperial unit of length equal to 12 inches or about 0.30 meters.
A fraction is a part of a whole number, such as ½, or one half.
A fulcrum is a pointed support that a lever rests upon.
A gallon is an imperial unit of volume equal to 128 fluid ounces or about 3.78 liters.
A gear is a rotating machine component that transmits torque by meshing its teeth with the teeth of another component.
A gear shaper is a machine tool that is used for cutting the teeth of gears.
A gram is a metric unit of weight equal to 1⁄1000 kilogram or about 0.035 ounces.
A groove is a long, narrow indentation.
A hacksaw is a saw with a narrow, fine-toothed blade.
A helical gear is a gear with teeth set at an angle in a spiral or helix pattern.
A honing machine is a machine tool that is used to create a smooth surface on metal.
A hundredth is a quantity that is equal to one divided by one hundred, and is expressed in the second place after a decimal point.
If a measurement is imperial, it uses the system that is based on the ounce and the foot.
An improper fraction is a quantity that is greater than one and is expressed strictly as a fraction.
To improve something is to make it better.
An inclined plane is a smooth surface with one end that is higher than the other.
An inner race is a metal cylinder that rotates with the shaft of a rolling contact bearing.
An input shaft is a shaft that receives power directly from a power source.
A joule is a derived unit that measures work or energy, and is equal to the energy required to apply one newton of force through the distance of one meter.
A journal bearing is a type of bearing in which the shaft is suspended on a thin layer of fluid inside a sleeve.
A kelvin is a unit of temperature that is part of the Kelvin scale, in which 0° is absolute zero and water freezes at 273.15°.
A kilogram is a metric unit of weight equal to 1000 grams or about 2.2 pounds.
A lathe is a machine tool that rotates a piece of wood, metal, or other material to shape it.
A lead screw is a screw with horizontal metal threads along a vertical body, which converts a rotating motion into the straight-line motion of a work surface.
A legend is a section on a graph or chart that provides information about its features and symbols.
A lever is a bar that rests on a fulcrum.
A line graph is a graph that displays data as a series of points connected by lines.
A link is an individual segment of chain.
A liter is a metric unit of volume equal to 1000 milliliters or about 33.8 fluid ounces.
A load is a particular amount of weight that someone or something supports or carries.
A machine tool is a power tool that is used for cutting or shaping metal, wood, or other materials.
To manufacture something is to build it in a factory, usually on a large scale.
A mechanical engineer is a person who studies and works with the physics and material applications of tools and machines.
To mesh is to come together and interlock.
A meter is a metric unit of length or distance equal to 100 centimeters or about 3.28 feet.
If a measurement is metric, it uses the system that is based on the gram and the meter.
A mill is a machine tool that is used to make surfaces flat, or to add grooves, holes, or slots.
A milliliter, also called a cubic centimeter, is a metric unit of volume equal to 1/1000 liter or about 0.03 fluid ounces.
If a number is minus another number, the second number is subtracted or taken away from the first number.
A mixed number is a quantity that is shown as a whole number and a fraction, with the fraction representing a value less than one.
To multiply a number (A) by another number (B) is to add number A to itself B number of times.
A newton is a derived unit that measures force, and is equal to the amount of force required to accelerate one kilogram of matter at one meter per second squared.
An ounce is an imperial unit of weight equal to 1/16 pound or about 28.35 grams.
If a quantity is x out of y, it has x parts per every y parts possible.
The outer race of a rolling contact bearing is a metal cylinder that remains stationary while the shaft rotates.
An output shaft is a shaft that transfers power to its destination in order to perform useful work.
If a number is over another number, it is divided by that number.
A pascal is a derived unit that measures pressure, and is equal to one newton per square meter.
A percent is a part of 100 that is usually represented by the “%” symbol.
A Phillips screwdriver is a tool for twisting screws that has a tip shaped like a cross.
A pie chart is a visual way to represent fractions and percentages in which a circle is divided into proportional parts, similar to slices in a pie.
A pinion is the driving gear of a gearset, and is usually smaller than the driven gear.
If a number is plus another number, the two numbers are added together.
A point is a dot placed after a whole unit in a decimal number.
A pound is an imperial unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or about 0.45 kilograms.
A pulley is a machine component that uses a wheel and a rope.
A quantity is an amount or numerical value.
A rack is a bar with gear teeth that a pinion moves along, converting rotational motion into linear motion.
If something is radial, it is related to movement across or perpendicular to the axis of something.
To reduce a fraction is to change it into the form with the lowest possible whole numbers.
If something is rigid, it is stiff and cannot bend without breaking.
A rolling contact bearing is a type of bearing that uses spherical or cylindrical rolling parts to bear weight and direct the motion of the shaft.
A rounding error is an inaccuracy that results from reducing the length of a decimal number, usually because of convenience or available space.
A row is a group of boxes that extends from the left to the right of a table.
A scatter plot is a graph that displays data as a series of unconnected points.
A sheave is a grooved pulley designed to work with a v-belt.

word: SI or International System of Units
definition: The SI, or International System of Units, is a widely used system of measurement that uses the same prefixes as the metric system.

A significant figure is a digit that identifies a quantity's level of precision, and includes all digits except for leading zeros, some trailing zeros, and digits exceeding those of the original quantity.
A simple machine is a basic machine with few moving parts.
A sledge hammer is a large and heavy hammer.
A sleeve is a metal tube through which a shaft moves.
A sleeve-style coupling is a rigid coupling in which two shafts meet inside a single tube.
A slotted screwdriver is a tool for twisting screws that has a straight and narrow tip.
A socket wrench is a wrench with multiple detachable sockets.
To specialize in a particular field is to have more detailed knowledge and skills in that area than any other area.
A spur gear is a type of gear in which the teeth protrude around the edge of a cylinder, and the faces of the gear teeth are parallel to the axis of rotation.
If a number is squared, it has an exponent of 2. For instance, 3 squared (32) equals 9, or 3 x 3 = 9.
A straight roller bearing is a rolling contact bearing that uses cylindrical rollers to direct motion.
To subtract one number from another number is to reduce it by that amount.
A table is a set of information that is organized into boxes.
A tapered roller bearing is a rolling contact bearing that uses uniform cone-shaped rollers to direct motion.
A tenth is a quantity that is equal to one divided by ten, and is expressed in the first place after a decimal point.
To test machinery is to observe its operations to determine whether it functions properly.
A thousandth is a quantity that is equal to one divided by one thousand, and is expressed in the third place after a decimal point.
A thrust roller bearing is a rolling contact bearing that uses barrel-shaped rollers to direct motion.
If a number is times another number, it is multiplied by that number.
A timing belt is a belt with teeth that ensures that machine parts move at regular time intervals.
If a number is raised to the nth power, it has an exponent of “n,” or is multiplied by itself “n” number of times. For example, 2 raised to the 5th power equals 25.
A tooth is a protrusion that is cut into a gear and fits together with other teeth in order to transmit torque.
A trailing zero is a zero that is used to occupy unused places after a decimal point, and serves as a placeholder rather than an actual value.
To transmit energy is to move it from one place to another.
A v-belt is a type of drive belt that is wider along one edge than the other, and is made from a reinforced synthetic rubber to increase friction.
A vice is a metal tool used to hold an object firmly in place.
A wedge is an object that becomes very narrow along one edge.
A wedge angle is a measurement of the sheave angle of a v-belt, and is used to determine the strength of the belt system.
A wheel is a circular object that is used to produce smooth, steady movements.
A whole number is a positive quantity that represents a complete unit, which does not contain fractions or figures after the decimal point.
A worm is a cylindrical, screw-like machine part with one tooth that wraps helically around it.
A worm gear is a gear designed to pair with a worm.
The x-axis, or horizontal axis, is the line that extends from the left to the right of a graph.
The y-axis, or vertical axis, is the line that extends from the top to the bottom of a graph.
A group of outcomes.
A collection of numbers that represent facts or provide information.
The entire group of interest to a researcher.
The middle value of a group of numbers.
A set made up of all values included in two or more sets.
A numerical calculation of how likely something is to occur.
The difference between the highest value and the lowest value in a data set.
A subset of a population meant to be representative of the population.
A way to solve a problem.
To change something's meaning.
A way of looking at something.
Intended to be repeated over and over again.
The ability to identify and address problems.
To make a determined effort to solve a problem.
The process of defining a problem.
An examination or report on something.
Force per unit of area applied to an object.
A place where something can exit something else.
The measurement of a quantity, such as frequency, applied over another quantity.
The power that causes an object to start or continue moving.
The measure of a liquid's resistance to being deformed.
A place where something can enter something else.
A process with results that depend on the movement of different variables.
The amount of something that passes through an area over a given time.
A set of properties or processes.
Occurring at the end of something.
The creation of something.
Something that goes into a system.
The act of using something.
A measurement that doesn't change with the amount of a substance.
Occurring at the beginning of something.
Something that is removed from a system.
